name: maven-dependency-issues
description: Resolving Maven dependency download failures and repository issues.
problem: Maven build fails with 'Could not resolve dependencies' or specific artifacts not found

approach_1_switch_repository.label: Switch to Maven Central Repository
steps: Add repository configuration pointing to Maven Central or Spring repositories

approach_2_remove_unavailable.label: Temporarily Remove Unavailable Dependencies
steps: Identify the missing dependency in the error message
Comment out the dependency in pom.xml
Re-add the dependency later when repository access is resolved

approach_3_clear_cache.label: Clear Maven Cache and Retry
steps: Verify network connection to Maven repositories
Retry build with verbose logging: `mvn clean install -X`
